reviews.title: Simple habit. Elevated Mindset.
reviews.text:
What I love 🩵 
- It’s a simple app
- Everything just works
- The Home Screen widget is great
- Reminders are functional & non-intrusive
- There is an export feature so you can pack up & go elsewhere when you’re ready.
- It’s easy to find/review past responses
- “On This Day” memories are always warm & make me happy to re-read months later
- Shuffling prompts keeps the inputs fresh & meaningful every time 

😕 Now for things I *don’t* super love
- I upgraded. Premium features are just as expected but yearly subscription cost is way too high IMO. 
- I can’t see myself spending $40/year on an app for this purpose YoY, no matter how cool it is. 
- Size of the Home Screen widget seems to limit the mantras to very few, would prefer smaller font vs. seeing the same affirmation every day or 4 days a week. 

🔮 At this cost, I’d be excited to see:
1. A functional referral program w/discounted premium subscription cost or 30/60-day trial for referrals only vs. just a link to the full price version
2. A way to gift premium memberships in bulk at a discount (like for a team at work)
3. Additional options for text formatting, ability to edit uploaded photos (even just crop/filter after upload would be amazing)
4. The ability to split the cost of circles w/a group or even make it possible for one person to pay a flat rate for the whole circle 
5. More options on gifting subscriptions; right now it just charges thru App Store but can’t tell if a person can gift w/o paying that way or how the other person gets notified. Process is unclear & could be explained better before payment is required. 
6. Custom fonts, colors, icons, #tags 

⭐️ Overall: Clean, functional app, nice interface, meaningful questions, and the value of a grateful lifestyle can’t be overstated. Won’t be a long-time subscriber just because I can convince myself once to spend too much on something, but not annually. I do love that there is an option on their site for anyone who can’t afford to spend the money on something like this so they can request access for free or at a discount. All around - a great app. Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Keeping connected
reviews.text: Our unit at work suddenly closed and we all joined this app to stay connected but also keep a positive outlook.  It has been so sweet to get to know each other in a different way plus encourage each other and focus on positivity during a hard time

reviews.title: Brings more joy to my life
reviews.text: Our daughter found this app and asked me and my husband to join the family group that she started. It has been awesome to see the things that each member of our family is grateful for that day and it helps us all to look for the good in our day and in our life and remember those things and to document them. I would recommend this app for sure!!  One thing I think would be fun to add to this app is the ability to make a book out of the gratitude posts and pics. It would be fun to have book to look back on. Our family loves to use this app.

reviews.title: Greatful
reviews.text: Grateful for the prompts and reminders. The app is very user friendly and making great connections. Never skimp on your mental health

reviews.title: Grace. Grit. Gratitude.
reviews.text: Journaling & documenting what I’m grateful for has helped me so much. I feel more blessed, thankful, and positive since I’ve started writing. I love that this app makes it possible to have social circles to connect with friends, partners, and family. The daily prompts are helpful and help you focus on truly what brings you joy. Being able to upload pictures is also a nice touch because a lot of times pictures speak for themselves. I couldn’t recommend this app more. I care more about keeping my gratitude streak going than all of my Snapchat streaks.

reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.text: I like how this app helps me to reflect on my day, even when things get busy. Having a friend circle is a great feature too: it helps me to connect with my loved ones and reminds me to share my appreciation! I wish I could’ve added more photos with a free version, but that’s ok.

reviews.title: Love it!!

I’ve been using it for almost 2 1/2 months now and I feel like it has helped my shift my perspective on life and I like to read what other people are thankful for. It was a little ‘hard’ when I first started but now I find it has gotten alot easier

reviews.title: So worth it!
reviews.text: I absolutely love this app! I have multiple circles with friends and family! My therapist even started recommending it to other patients because I was telling her how amazing it is. If you’re worried about the free version being worth it or not, it is!!! I pay for the subscription, however, none of my friends or family do and they love it too!! It has helped shift my mindset to a more positive and grateful way of thinking. I will forever tell everyone and anyone about Gratitude Plus!! Plus I love the stream aspect. I’m up to 313 days!!

reviews.title: Love starting with the free option
reviews.text: Only two days in and I am really enjoying getting used to the app with the free version. I don’t feel pressure to get used to all the features before a trial runs out. Might upgrade later but the free option is really great for starting out!
